video_prompt: One continuous vertical front-camera phone video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. A young East Asian man with messy textured black hair, thin black glasses and no beard, in a plain olive-green hoodie, sits alone on his bed in a dark bedroom at night lit by a cool bluish monitor glow, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. The phone is held steady at arm's length; the room behind him stays still and dim. He talks straight into the camera in a confident, conspiratorial tone, like telling a friend a secret, with small natural head movements.
